## Problem
What problem does this change solve?

## Architecture impact
Which domain, application, port, adapter, data, retrieval, evaluation, or delivery boundary changes?

## Decision
What approach was selected and why?

## Scope
What changed?

## Out of scope
What is deliberately not changing?

## Expected behavior
What should be true after this change?

## Validation
- [ ] `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run mypy src tests`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv build`
- [ ] Relevant integration tests, if applicable
- [ ] Relevant AI/RAG evals, if applicable

## Evidence
Add test output, screenshots, example records, evaluation comparison, or other evidence appropriate to the change.

## Risks / follow-ups
What is intentionally deferred, risky, or worth watching after merge?

## Documentation / ADR impact
- [ ] No architecture/documentation change needed
- [ ] Relevant living documentation updated
- [ ] ADR added or updated where a material architecture decision changed
